method: warm-start large-neighbourhood search with symmetry group T (rotations of the tetrahedron, 12 elements) started from the T-symmetric rule CA-C3-28-1132-PI-MPC (itself found from the Td rule CA-C3-28-1133-PI-MPC): code/cubature_search.py --refine (orbit elimination and simulated annealing); minimised sum of w^2 with tools/minimize_l2.py; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz

reproduce.command: stage 1: python code/cubature_search.py --nmin 28 --nmax 28 --group T --refine 3300 --out <dir1> --sources <dir with cube3d_n28_m1133_atlas.txt> --jobs 1 --seed 71; stage 2: python code/cubature_search.py --nmin 28 --nmax 28 --group T --refine 3600 --out <dir2> --sources <dir with the 1132 result of stage 1 as cube3d_n28_m1132_atlas.txt> --jobs 1 --seed 73
